title: A laboratory simulation to investigate effects of moistures on U distribution among solid phase components in army range soils
author: Cooper, Olafuyi, et al.

steps.title: Complete radiosafety training
steps.instruction: All personnel must attend radiosafety training and obtain a safety certificate after passing the test.

steps.title: Use hood and PPE
steps.instruction: Conduct all experiments inside a fume hood while wearing chemical gloves and 3M masks in accordance with OSHA standards.

steps.title: Prepare composite arid soil
steps.instruction: Collect five subsamples from 0–15 cm depth at Yuma Proving Ground, combine them, air‑dry, and grind through a 2 mm sieve.

steps.title: Obtain and grind U chemicals
steps.instruction: Purchase uranyl, UO₂, and UO₃ from United Nuclear Scientific Equipment and Supplies; collect schoepite from DU‑contaminated fields at Yuma; grind all uranium chemicals and schoepite with an agate mortar to achieve uniform fineness.

steps.title: Spike soil with 100 mg kg⁻¹ U
steps.instruction: Using the gradual dilution method, add uranium to achieve 100 mg kg⁻¹ U in the soil; mix 500 g of the spiked soil in a plastic beaker with a cap.

steps.title: Set moisture regimes
steps.instruction: Establish three moisture conditions: (a) saturated paste at 25 % moisture, (b) field capacity at 70 % of water saturation, and (c) wetting‑drying cycle by bringing soil to field capacity then allowing it to air‑dry.

steps.title: Incubate soils at room temperature
steps.instruction: Place the spiked soils under each moisture regime at room temperature and duplicate each treatment.

steps.title: Maintain moisture and sample over time
steps.instruction: Incubate soils for 1 day, 1 week, 2 weeks, and 1 month; keep moisture constant by adding water to reach the predefined regime throughout incubation.

steps.title: Collect subsamples for dissolution
steps.instruction: At each designated incubation time, remove a subsample for sequential selective dissolution and a parallel subsample for moisture determination.

steps.title: Extract water‑soluble U
steps.instruction: Perform the water‑soluble extraction on the collected soil.

substeps.instruction: Weigh ~1 g ground soil into a 50 mL centrifuge tube.
Add 25 mL deionized water.
Shake for 2 h.
Centrifuge and collect the supernatant.
Filter the supernatant through a 0.45 µm filter.
Retain the residue for the next extraction step.

steps.title: Extract exchangeable U
steps.instruction: Perform the exchangeable extraction on the residue from the water‑soluble step.

substeps.instruction: Add 25 mL of 1 M NH₄NO₃ (pH 7.0 adjusted with NH₄OH and diluted HNO₃) to the residue.
Agitate for 30 min at room temperature.
Centrifuge, decant the supernatant and filter it.
Keep the remaining residue for the next extraction step.

steps.title: Extract carbonate‑bound U
steps.instruction: Perform the carbonate extraction on the residue from the exchangeable step.

substeps.instruction: Add 25 mL of CH₃COONa buffer (pH 5.00, adjusted with NH₄OH and diluted HNO₃) to the residue.
Agitate for 6 h.
Centrifuge and collect the supernatant.
Retain the residue for the next extraction step.

steps.title: Extract easily reducible oxide U
steps.instruction: Perform the easily reducible oxide extraction on the residue from the carbonate step.

substeps.instruction: Add 25 mL of 0.01 M HCl to the residue.
Agitate for 30 min.
Centrifuge and collect the supernatant.
Keep the residue for the next extraction step.

steps.title: Extract organic‑matter bound U
steps.instruction: Perform the organic‑matter extraction on the residue from the easily reducible oxide step.

substeps.instruction: Add 3 mL of 0.01 M HNO₃ and 5 mL of 30 % H₂O₂ to the residue.
Digest in a water bath at 80 °C for 2 h.
Add an additional 2 mL of 30 % H₂O₂ and heat for 1 h.
Add 15 mL of 1 M NH₄NO₃ and agitate for 10 min.
Centrifuge and collect the supernatant.
Retain the residue for the next extraction step.

steps.title: Extract amorphous Fe‑oxide U
steps.instruction: Perform the amorphous iron‑oxide extraction on the residue from the organic‑matter step.

substeps.instruction: Mix the residue with 25 mL of 0.2 M oxalate buffer.
Agitate for 4 h.
Centrifuge and collect the supernatant.
Keep the residue for the next extraction step.

steps.title: Extract crystalline Fe‑oxide U
steps.instruction: Perform the crystalline iron‑oxide extraction on the residue from the amorphous Fe‑oxide step.

substeps.instruction: Add 25 mL of 0.04 M NH₂OH·HCl in 25 % acetic acid to the residue.
Digest in a water bath at 97–100 °C for 3 h.
Centrifuge and collect the supernatant.
Retain the residue for the final digestion step.

steps.title: Digest residual fraction
steps.instruction: Perform the residual digestion on the residue from the crystalline Fe‑oxide step.

substeps.instruction: Add 25 mL of 4 M HNO₃ to the residue.
Digest in a water bath at 80 °C for 16 h.
Centrifuge and collect the supernatant.

steps.title: Dilute extracts and measure U
steps.instruction: Dilute each collected supernatant as required and determine uranium concentrations using ICP‑MS and ICP‑OES.

substeps.instruction: Dilute each extract to the appropriate concentration for analysis.
Measure uranium in each diluted extract with inductively coupled plasma‑mass spectrometry (ICP‑MS).
Measure uranium in each diluted extract with inductively coupled plasma‑optical emission spectrometry (ICP‑OES).
